summary: A plant operator takes a checkout debate back to the time lost clearing the sorting equipment.
realLife: Washington Senate report on SB 5323, 2019. Senate supporters described flexible plastic wrapping around sorting machinery and conveyors and requiring labor to clear it.
inGame: needs: a recovery facility records a stoppage caused by loose bag film.
gates: A recovery facility records a stoppage caused by loose bag film.

turns.what: A load reaches the end of the line without interruption.
turns.pulledBy: The next incoming load contains no loose film.
turns.writesBack: That load passes without a bag-related stoppage.

turns.what: Workers move unsorted material off the line.
turns.pulledBy: Only part of the load can reach the sorter.
turns.writesBack: Crews record diverted material as well as downtime.
